The name Mehrunissa signifies the one who is the light of the heart, illuminating the path of love in one's life. The name Mehrunissa carries the meaning “Light of the heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehrunissa usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
